MC_endpoints.alternative_power_label: Synthetic partial power only, with precision; not>=.90 market-power certification and no minimum power pass threshold selected after outcomes.
MC_endpoints.ceiling_note: Nominal endpoint error plus.03 exploratory tolerance. These thresholds do not establish exact nominal coverage or market validity and do not change the historical .08/.13 decisions.
MC_endpoints.inconclusive: Otherwise, including incomplete budget stop, unsupported scope or excessive interval uncertainty. No same-plan top-up of replicates.
MC_endpoints.intervals: Two-sided exact Clopper-Pearson, per-endpoint error=.05/18, for at-least95% simultaneous Monte Carlo confidence over the18declared null-case endpoints. Also report individual95% intervals, clearly separate.
MC_endpoints.nominal_coverage_evidence: Separately flag a lower CP bound above the nominal alpha; a tolerance screen pass is never a proof of exact level.
MC_endpoints.pass: Every corresponding simultaneous upper CP bound is <= its declared ceiling, support failures are absent within the claimed regular scope, all cases completed and all source hashes unchanged. Only passes limited screen.
MC_endpoints.reject: Any corresponding simultaneous lower CP bound exceeds the ceiling, or derivation/code integrity is violated. Keep findings and stop approval.

before_any_random_execution: Complete root approximation and computable simultaneous bias-bound construction; account for near-zero risk and interaction.
Fix code, DGP generator and analytic mean-of-individual-RMSE truths, variance bounds, pairing and all identities by hash.

Supply separate population_Psi, finite_design_tau and structural-bias-bound oracles, with certified deterministic numerical error; preserve an inconclusive classification if numerical uncertainty crosses a decision boundary.
Choose one repair before results; no post-result selection among bias bound, jackknife and a changed estimand.
Resolve p/interval inversion and multiplicity for the chosen limited scope; if not derived, study intervals only and do not claim p validity.
Review the proposal counts, error allocation, exact CP tails and hard resource ceiling, then freeze a final new version publicly.
Measure implementation feasibility on a separately declared deterministic timing fixture without inspecting Monte Carlo outcomes; if infeasible, revise and freeze before sampling, or do not run.
purpose: Limited methodological validation of centered-root and Jensen-bias-aware intervals, if their missing derivation and code become defensible. Not validation of full R3 or a market campaign.

regularity_and_edge_cases.invalid_studentizer_or_covariance: Retain case/model slot, p1 if a p interface is used, interval absent, support failure recorded, no victory.
regularity_and_edge_cases.structural_zero_mu: Analytic q=0 a.s. case checked separately; an observed zero does not establish this.
regularity_and_edge_cases.support_case_near_zero_positive_mu: Derive bound integrability; if insufficient, mark outside supported scope, never impose an epsilon to assert population positivity.

required_distinct_truth_oracles.bias_bound_event: Freeze the conservative sufficient event Bhat_m >= B_m_structural simultaneously for every model, where B_m_structural=E_seed[Var(qbar_T|seed)/(2mu(seed)^1.5)]. Do not silently switch later to a weaker empirical event.
required_distinct_truth_oracles.finite_design_tau: E_seed,time(thetahat_j) for the exact R/T and generator, computed independently of the validation draws. Required to score centered-root coverage; population_Psi alone is insufficient.
required_distinct_truth_oracles.oracle_precision: Closed-form calculation or deterministic integration with certified error accounted for in all endpoint classifications. No plug-in Monte Carlo truth from current or prior validation outputs. Numerical ambiguous cases remain inconclusive.
required_distinct_truth_oracles.population_Psi: E_seed sqrt(E_time q|seed), derived for every model; not sqrt(E_seed E_time q).

research_revision: Keep observed mean individual RMSE; investigate [L_root-B_candidate,U_root+B_rival]. No numerical bias bound has been estimated.

resources.stop_rule: If final feasibility does not fit, do not start. If an eventual run reaches the frozen cap, preserve an incomplete/inconclusive receipt, no selective omission or top-up.

root_and_bias_error_allocation_proposed.scope: Only if the two simultaneous probability guarantees are actually derived; .04/.01 are internal proposed choices, not guide requirements.

source_controls: Existing studies and artifacts are read-only historical references; no historical Monte Carlo study is rerun by this package.

cases.definition: All population risks equal, only seed amplitudes vary; q constant in time. Isolates seed inference; exact temporal bias is zero.
Equal population risks with stationary Gaussian AR dependence phi=.35 and common calendar effects.
